lines.369680625204539392:
I thought I was going to have to walk all the way back into town, you’re a lifesaver! 
Can you believe my stupid ex boyfriend dumped me out here all by myself? 
What if something happened? Good thing you came along. A real gentleman.
lines.369680625204539394: He’s probably already back in town, drinking with his buddies, laughing his ass off.
lines.369680625204539395: I should pay him a visit.
lines.369680625208733696: Oh... Really? You’re full of surprises, mister! This could turn into one hell of a night!
lines.369680625229705216: On a back road to nowhere, past misdeeds won’t go unpunished.
lines.369680625233899521: You sure showed him, mister! You showed him good! He won’t be bothering no one for a while!
lines.369680625233899523: You got me all excited, seeing you with that man, puttin’ the hurt on him. What’s a girl gotta do to get on your naughty list?
lines.369680625233899524: You don’t have anything to worry about.
lines.369680625233899525: Oh, but I’ve been plenty bad, mister. As bad as you need me to, and that’s God’s honest truth.
lines.369680625263259648: The Driver knows what you did. The Driver never rests. The Driver is coming for you.
lines.369680625263259649: Thanks for the ride, you sure know how to show a girl a good time! Don’t be a stranger, hot stuff.
lines.369680625267453952: I see you. I SEE YOU.
lines.369680625284231168: The Driver is hunting his final quarry.
lines.369680625292619777: Walker. This is it. End of the line. I will find you.
lines.369680625292619778: Who is this man and what has he done to earn the attention of the Driver? Terminal Drive is about to reach its explosive finale.
lines.369680625317785600: Fate hangs in a balance as the Driver is down for the count.
lines.369680625317785602: The fires of dark retribution still burn hot and black. Will the wicked go unpunished, or will the Driver rise again to finish what he started?
lines.369680625321979904: I had done what I came here to do. Not by choice. Not by reason. Just pure necessity.
lines.369680625321979905: Whatever it meant, I had gotten the job done and escaped in one piece.
lines.369680625321979906: Mr Jackman is happy, I’m happy.
lines.369680625326174208: The paycheck will go a long way to help me forget Silver Pines and everything in it.
lines.369680625330368512: The forest stretches out all around me and the road seems to go on forever.
lines.369680625368117249: I have to know. I have to find out. Please!
lines.369680625368117250: I’m sorry. It doesn’t really matter. None of that matters.
lines.369680625372311552: Maybe I missed something, it doesn’t add up…
lines.369680625372311553: You have to let go of all of that. You can’t go back now. We’re here, and the sun is rising.
lines.369680625372311554: That’s all there is to it.
lines.369680625372311555: Then why do I feel so sad?
lines.369680625372311557: It’s okay to be sad. Maybe things could have been different, but what does that even mean?
lines.369680625376505856: This is the way things happened, and we both played our parts.
lines.369680625376505857: It’s time to stop struggling and just rest.
